paragraphs: The Citan 113 is a current petrol variant of Mercedes-Benz's compact van, part of the second-generation W420 model range introduced in 2021. It is powered by the M282 — a 1.3-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. The M282 is a modern, turbocharged unit co-developed with Renault, and is fitted alongside the diesel variants in the Citan line-up. No widely reported engine issue has been confirmed for this specific application, though we still recommend a full inspection before any long journey.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every CITAN 113 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the CITAN 113 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
